_note: Model profiles. Shared by tools\Build-GhostAgent.ps1 (what to download and verify) and GhostAgent\agent\ghost_agent.py (how to run it). Every file is pinned to a Hugging Face revision and a SHA-256.
_fields: For the agent: takes_reasoning_effort = the chat template reads reasoning_effort (sent only then); preserve_reasoning = what the preserve_reasoning setting "auto" means for this profile; ram_gb = the free RAM the model needs, for the warning before loading. Without them the agent infers them (dense models take reasoning_effort and keep their reasoning; RAM from the file size).

fast.label: Holo4-35B-A3B Q4_K_M (H Company)
fast.description: Mixture of experts, about 3B active parameters per token: the fastest option on an 8 GB GPU.

fast-q8.label: Holo4-35B-A3B Q8_0 (community quant by bartowski)
fast-q8.description: Same model at 8-bit precision. Explicit trade-off: closer to the original weights, but each step is slower and it needs about 44-48 GB of RAM.

accurate.label: Holo4-27B Q4_K_M (H Company)
accurate.description: H Company's most capable model (dense, all 27B parameters active). Explicit trade-off: noticeably better on long tasks, but several times slower per step on an 8 GB GPU. Non-commercial license.
